summary.business_type: EdTech / Online Language Learning Platform (Bilingual Bangla-English)

top_findings.title: Raw HTML Streams Skeleton Instead of Static H1 for Crawlers
Article Heading Hierarchy Skips H2 (Jumps from H1 to H3)
Vocabulary Meta Descriptions Exceed Optimal Length (>200 characters)

quick_wins: Add /llms.txt with site summary and core CEFR directory links
Update robots.ts with explicit AI user-agents and Content-Signal
Add H2 sections in written article templates (/written/[slug])
Trim vocabulary meta descriptions to 155 characters

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Enforced HTTPS with strict HSTS (max-age=63072000)
Vercel Edge CDN with valid ETag and cache-control headers
Clean canonical tags across all tested pages
Valid XML sitemap linked in robots.txt

findings.title: Client-Side Hydration Renders Skeleton in Initial HTML
findings.description: When search bots crawl without JavaScript execution, the initial server response contains skeleton placeholder divs instead of the rendered H1 headline.
findings.recommendation: Render the static H1 headline and hero copy server-side directly in HomeOrDashboard without waiting for auth store hydration.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers in HTTP Response
findings.description: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options, and Content-Security-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add standard security headers inside next.config.ts headers() hook.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Rich bilingual Bangla-English educational content
Structured CEFR graded vocabulary from A1 to C1
Verified author and founder profiles with social proof (sameAs)
Detailed model paragraphs with multi-tier difficulty levels

findings.title: Article Author Schema Missing Profile @id Link
findings.description: Article schema lists author as a plain name string rather than linking to the author entity defined in Organization.
findings.recommendation: Link Article author to founder/person @id in JSON-LD markup.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Targeted title tags matching high-volume Bengali search queries
Complete OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata
100% image alt text coverage on sampled pages

findings.title: Heading Hierarchy Gap in Written Articles
findings.description: Written articles have an H1 followed directly by H3 tags, skipping the H2 heading level.
findings.recommendation: Restructure article subheadings to use H2 tags for main sections (e.g., 'Model Paragraph', 'Bengali Meaning', 'Vocabulary Notes').

findings.title: Meta Description Length Exceeds SERP Snippet Bounds
findings.description: Vocabulary page meta descriptions average 214 characters, causing truncation in Google mobile SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Cap dynamic meta descriptions at 155 characters.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema with founder details, logo, contact points, and sameAs links
WebSite schema with SearchAction for site search box
BreadcrumbList schema on written and vocabulary subpages
Valid Article schema with datePublished and dateModified

findings.title: Vocabulary Pages Lack DefinedTermSet Schema
findings.description: Dictionary and vocabulary list pages currently rely only on BreadcrumbList and WebSite.
findings.recommendation: Implement DefinedTermSet or ItemList schema for vocabulary words.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Fast server response times from Vercel Edge (<150ms)
Preloaded WOFF2 variable fonts
Optimized image assets served via ImageKit CDN

findings.title: Potential LCP Delay on Hero Sketch Highlight Elements
findings.description: Client-rendered SVG doodle animations in hero could shift LCP timing on slower mobile CPUs.
findings.recommendation: Ensure hero text renders with CSS font-display: swap without waiting for animation libraries.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Fact-dense bilingual tables and example sentences ideal for LLM retrieval
High entity clarity with CEFR levels and linguistic definitions

findings.title: Missing llms.txt & llms-full.txt Files
findings.description: AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude) look for /llms.txt to index structured knowledge about the platform.
findings.recommendation: Add a public/llms.txt summarizing Zero English, CEFR tiers, and key learning resources.

findings.title: Missing AI Bot Directives in robots.txt
findings.description: robots.txt has no explicit rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, or PerplexityBot, and lacks Content-Signal declarations.
findings.recommendation: Update src/app/robots.ts to explicitly welcome AI search engines while managing training scrapers.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of tested images have descriptive alt attributes
Next.js optimized Image components with lazy loading
CDN-hosted assets via ImageKit

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical & Crawlability Fixes
items: Prerender Hero H1 server-side on homepage so search bots receive static text immediately
Publish public/llms.txt for AI search citation indexing
Add AI bot rules and Content-Signal in src/app/robots.ts

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact On-Page & Schema Enhancements
items: Fix heading hierarchy in written articles (/written/[slug]) to include proper H2 tags
Trim vocabulary programmatic meta descriptions to 155 characters
Link Article author schema to founder Person entity (@id)

phases.name: Phase 3: Security & Structured Data Breadth
items: Add security headers in next.config.ts (X-Content-Type-Options, CSP, X-Frame-Options)
Add DefinedTermSet schema on vocabulary pages (/vocabulary/[level]/[page])
